splash.welcome.p1.title: A new item appeared on the left — Agent
splash.welcome.p1.body: Ask UAgent for help with game launch issues, get advice on installing mods, find mods you like, build modpacks, and trust the agent with creating and managing your builds.
splash.welcome.p2.title: Testers only for now
splash.welcome.p2.body: AI features in this version are available in closed form with a tester key. Without a valid code the agent tab and AI tools stay locked — you can enter the key later in settings.
splash.welcome.p3.title: Enable agent features?
splash.welcome.p3.body: You can show the Agent tab in the sidebar right away. Enter a tester key in settings when you need it.

splash.welcome.p4on.title: You are in the Future now
splash.welcome.p4on.body: Thanks for making our project better! UAgent is waiting in the Agent tab — enter a tester key in settings when you need it.
splash.welcome.p4off.title: All set
splash.welcome.p4off.body: You can always enable the new features in settings — the UAgent section. When you are ready, turn the agent on and enter a tester key.
